candidates.title: node: make suiclient subscription coverage deterministic
candidates.body:
## Problem

`node-coverage-check` fails on some PRs that do not touch `suiclient`, for example #5054. The tests pass, but the percentage for `suiclient` is different from one run to the next. The baseline has 121 of 167 statements covered, `main` has 120, and #5054 has 119.

candidates.title: Add testutils pkg; use TimeFromUnix when building message publications
candidates.body:
Use the SDK's new [TimeFromUnix](https://github.com/wormhole-foundation/wormhole/blob/2771cd01da6e83ccf3ab3991357af0afb17cfc0b/sdk/vaa/structs.go#L215) timestamp validation function at all call sites, including in test code. 

This normalizes timestamp validation to avoid niche overflow scenarios as well as divergences between various types used to represent timestamps in the Go code. It adds an error-handling step but it also makes it so that authors don't need to know the implementation details of how a timestamp is represented.
